title: argument parser with case and shift
code:
set -euo pipefail
verbose=0; dry_run=0
output="result.txt"
mode="default"
while [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    -v|--verbose)
      verbose=1; shift
      ;;
    -n|--dry-run)
      dry_run=1; shift
      ;;
    -o|--output)
      output="${2:?missing value for $1}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    -m|--mode)
      mode="${2:?missing value for $1}"
      shift 2
      ;;
    --)
      shift; break
      ;;
    -*)
      echo "error: unknown flag '$1'" >&2
      exit 1
      ;;
    *)
      break
      ;;
  esac
done
echo "verbose=${verbose} dry_run=${dry_run}"
echo "output=${output} mode=${mode}"
echo "remaining args: $*"
notes: Implements a command line argument parser using the while-case-shift idiom with error handling.

title: log rotation with age check

set -euo pipefail
log_dir="/var/log/myapp"
max_age=30
now=$(date +%s)
archived=0
for logfile in "${log_dir}"/*.log; do
  [ -f "${logfile}" ] || continue
  mtime=$(stat -c '%Y' "${logfile}" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -z "${mtime}" ] && continue
  age=$(( (now - mtime) / 86400 ))
  if [ "${age}" -gt "${max_age}" ]; then
    gzip "${logfile}"
    echo "archived: ${logfile} (${age}d)"

done

title: parallel task runner with concurrency limit

set -euo pipefail

job_count=0

run_task() {
  local id="${1}"
  local delay="${2:-1}"
  echo "[start] task ${id} (${delay}s)"
  sleep "${delay}"
  echo "[done]  task ${id}"
}

for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  delay=$((RANDOM % 3 + 1))
  run_task "${i}" "${delay}" &
  job_count=$((job_count + 1))
  if [ "${job_count}" -ge "${MAX_JOBS}" ]; then

title: recursive directory size scanner
code:
set -euo pipefail
target="${1:-.}"
threshold="${2:-1024}"

scan() {
  local dir="${1}"
  local depth="${2}"
  local prefix=""
  for ((d=0; d<depth; d++)); do
    prefix="${prefix}  "
  done
  for entry in "${dir}"/*; do
    [ -e "${entry}" ] || continue
    if [ -d "${entry}" ]; then
      local kb
      kb=$(du -sk "${entry}" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
      if [ "${kb:-0}" -gt "${threshold}" ]; then
        printf '%s[%dK] %s/\n' "${prefix}" "${kb}" "$(basename "${entry}")"
        scan "${entry}" $((depth + 1))
      fi
    fi
  done
}

echo "dirs over ${threshold}K in ${target}:"
scan "${target}" 0
notes: Recursively scans directories printing those exceeding a size threshold in a tree format.

title: git branch cleanup with protection
code:
set -euo pipefail
dry_run=1
protected="main|develop|release"
count=0

[ "${1:-}" = "--force" ] && dry_run=0

while IFS= read -r branch; do
  branch="${branch## }"
  [ -z "${branch}" ] && continue
  if [[ "${branch}" =~ ^(${protected})$ ]]; then
    echo "[KEEP] ${branch} (protected)"
    continue
  fi
  if [ "${dry_run}" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "[DRY]  would delete: ${branch}"
  else
    if git branch -d "${branch}" 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "[DEL]  ${branch}"
    else
      echo "[SKIP] ${branch} (not fully merged)" >&2
    fi
  fi
  count=$((count + 1))
done < <(git branch --merged main 2>/dev/null)

echo "${count} merged branch(es) found"
[ "${dry_run}" -eq 1 ] && echo "(pass --force to delete)"
notes: Lists or removes local git branches merged into main while protecting named branches.

title: multi-environment deploy orchestrator
code:
set -euo pipefail
declare -A envs=([staging]="stg01:2222" [production]="prod01:2222" [canary]="canary01:2222")
artifact="${1:?usage: deploy <tarball> [env]}"
target_env="${2:-staging}"
log_file="/var/log/deploy_$(date +%s).log"

log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$*" | tee -a "${log_file}"; }

validate() {
  local f="${1}"
  [ -f "${f}" ] || { log "ERROR: not found: ${f}"; return 1; }
  tar -tzf "${f}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "ERROR: bad tarball: ${f}"; return 1; }
}

deploy_to() {
  local env="${1}"
  local spec="${envs[${env}]}"
  local host="${spec%%:*}"
  local port="${spec##*:}"
  log "deploying to ${env} (${host}:${port})"
  if scp -P "${port}" "${artifact}" "${host}:/opt/releases/"; then
    if ssh -p "${port}" "${host}" '/opt/bin/activate.sh'; then
      log "OK: ${env} deployed"
      return 0
    else
      log "FAIL: activation on ${env}" >&2
    fi
  else
    log "FAIL: upload to ${env}" >&2
  fi
  return 1
}

validate "${artifact}"
if deploy_to "${target_env}"; then
  log "deploy to ${target_env} complete"
else
  log "deploy to ${target_env} FAILED" >&2
  exit 1
fi
notes: Deploys an artifact to a named environment via SSH with validation and structured logging.

title: log analyzer with severity tracking
code:
set -euo pipefail
log_file="${1:-/var/log/app.log}"
report="analysis_$(date +%Y%m%d).txt"
declare -A counts=([INFO]=0 [WARN]=0 [ERROR]=0 [FATAL]=0)
declare -A patterns

while IFS= read -r line; do
  for lvl in INFO WARN ERROR FATAL; do
    if [[ "${line}" == *"[${lvl}]"* ]]; then
      counts[${lvl}]=$(( ${counts[${lvl}]} + 1 ))
      if [ "${lvl}" = "ERROR" ] || [ "${lvl}" = "FATAL" ]; then
        msg="${line##*] }"
        msg="${msg:0:60}"
        if [ -n "${patterns[${msg}]+x}" ]; then
          patterns["${msg}"]=$(( ${patterns[${msg}]} + 1 ))
        else
          patterns["${msg}"]=1
        fi
      fi
      break
    fi
  done
done < "${log_file}"

{
  echo "=== Severity Counts ==="
  for lvl in INFO WARN ERROR FATAL; do
    printf '%-8s %d\n' "${lvl}" "${counts[${lvl}]}"
  done
  echo ""
  echo "=== Error Patterns ==="
  for p in "${!patterns[@]}"; do
    printf '%4d  %s\n' "${patterns[${p}]}" "${p}"
  done
} > "${report}"
echo "report: ${report}"
notes: Analyzes a log file counting severity levels and grouping unique error patterns into a report.

title: database backup with rotation
code:
set -euo pipefail
DB_HOST="${DB_HOST:-localhost}"
DB_PORT="${DB_PORT:-5432}"
DB_USER="${DB_USER:-postgres}"
BKP="/var/backups/db"
KEEP=14
ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S)

log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$*"; }

mkdir -p "${BKP}"
for db in $(psql -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" -At \
  -c "SELECT datname FROM pg_database WHERE NOT datistemplate"); do
  out="${BKP}/${db}_${ts}.sql.gz"
  log "dumping ${db}"
  if pg_dump -h "${DB_HOST}" -p "${DB_PORT}" -U "${DB_USER}" "${db}" | gzip > "${out}"; then
    sz=$(du -sh "${out}" | cut -f1)
    log "OK: ${db} (${sz})"
  else
    log "FAIL: ${db}" >&2
    rm -f "${out}"
  fi
done

log "pruning backups older than ${KEEP} days"
find "${BKP}" -name '*.sql.gz' -mtime +"${KEEP}" -exec rm -v {} \;

total=$(find "${BKP}" -name '*.sql.gz' | wc -l)
log "${total} backup(s) retained"
notes: Backs up all non-template PostgreSQL databases with compression and removes old backups.

title: interactive task manager with select
code:
set -euo pipefail
declare -a tasks=()
count=0

add() {
  tasks+=("${1}")
  count=$((count + 1))
  echo "added #${count}: ${1}"
}

list() {
  [ "${count}" -eq 0 ] && { echo "(empty)"; return; }
  for i in $(seq 0 $((count - 1))); do
    printf '%3d. %s\n' "$((i + 1))" "${tasks[${i}]}"
  done
}

remove() {
  local idx="${1}"
  if [ "${idx}" -lt 0 ] || [ "${idx}" -ge "${count}" ]; then
    echo "invalid index" >&2; return 1
  fi
  echo "removed: ${tasks[${idx}]}"
  unset 'tasks[${idx}]'
  tasks=("${tasks[@]}")
  count=$((count - 1))
}

while true; do
  echo ""
  select action in "Add" "List" "Remove" "Quit"; do
    case "${action}" in
      Add)
        read -rp "desc: " d
        add "${d}"
        ;;
      List)
        list
        ;;
      Remove)
        list
        read -rp "number: " n
        remove $((n - 1))
        ;;
      Quit)
        echo "bye"; exit 0
        ;;
    esac
    break
  done
done
notes: Implements an interactive task list with add, list, and remove via a select menu loop.

title: system resource monitor with alerts
code:
set -euo pipefail
interval="${1:-5}"
thresh=90
log_dir="/var/log/monitor"
mkdir -p "${log_dir}"

get_cpu() {
  local u
  u=$(top -bn1 | awk '/Cpu\(s\)/{print int($2+$4)}')
  echo "${u:-0}"
}

get_mem() {
  local p
  p=$(free | awk '/Mem:/{printf "%.0f",$3/$2*100}')
  echo "${p:-0}"
}

get_disk() {
  local p
  p=$(df / | awk 'NR==2{sub(/%/,"",$5);print $5}')
  echo "${p:-0}"
}

while true; do
  ts=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
  cpu=$(get_cpu); mem=$(get_mem); disk=$(get_disk)
  printf '[%s] CPU=%3d%%  MEM=%3d%%  DISK=%3d%%\n' "${ts}" "${cpu}" "${mem}" "${disk}"
  for metric in cpu mem disk; do
    val="${!metric}"
    if [ "${val}" -gt "${thresh}" ]; then
      echo "ALERT: ${metric}=${val}%%" | tee -a "${log_dir}/alerts.log" >&2
    fi
  done
  sleep "${interval}"
done
notes: Polls CPU, memory, and disk usage in a loop and logs alerts when thresholds are exceeded.

title: plugin loader with dependency resolution
code:
set -euo pipefail
declare -A plugin_deps
declare -A plugin_state
declare -a load_order
PDIR="${1:-/opt/plugins}"

scan() {
  for mf in "${PDIR}"/*/plugin.conf; do
    [ -f "${mf}" ] || continue
    local n="" d=""
    while IFS='=' read -r k v; do
      k="${k## }"; k="${k%% }"
      v="${v## }"; v="${v%% }"
      case "${k}" in
        name) n="${v}" ;;
        depends) d="${v}" ;;
      esac
    done < "${mf}"
    [ -n "${n}" ] && { plugin_deps["${n}"]="${d}"; plugin_state["${n}"]=0; }
  done
}

load() {
  local nm="${1}"
  [ "${plugin_state[${nm}]:-}" = "1" ] && return 0
  if [ "${plugin_state[${nm}]:-}" = "loading" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: circular dep on ${nm}" >&2; return 1
  fi
  plugin_state["${nm}"]="loading"
  local ds="${plugin_deps[${nm}]:-}"
  if [ -n "${ds}" ]; then
    IFS=',' read -ra dl <<< "${ds}"
    for dep in "${dl[@]}"; do
      dep="${dep## }"; dep="${dep%% }"
      if [ -z "${plugin_deps[${dep}]+x}" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: unknown dep '${dep}' for '${nm}'" >&2; return 1
      fi
      load "${dep}" || return 1
    done
  fi
  local init="${PDIR}/${nm}/init.sh"
  [ -f "${init}" ] && source "${init}"
  plugin_state["${nm}"]=1
  load_order+=("${nm}")
  echo "loaded: ${nm}"
}

scan
for pn in "${!plugin_deps[@]}"; do
  load "${pn}" || echo "SKIP: ${pn}" >&2
done
echo ""
echo "=== Load Order ==="
for i in $(seq 0 $((${#load_order[@]} - 1))); do
  printf '%2d. %s\n' "$((i + 1))" "${load_order[${i}]}"
done
notes: Scans plugin manifests resolving dependencies recursively with circular dependency detection.

title: build system with dependency graph
code:
set -euo pipefail
declare -A tgt_cmd
declare -A tgt_deps
declare -A tgt_built
BD="${BUILD_DIR:-.build}"

define() {
  local nm="${1}" dp="${2}" cm="${3}"
  tgt_cmd["${nm}"]="${cm}"
  tgt_deps["${nm}"]="${dp}"
  tgt_built["${nm}"]=0
}

build() {
  local nm="${1}"
  [ "${tgt_built[${nm}]:-0}" -eq 1 ] && return 0
  if [ -z "${tgt_cmd[${nm}]+x}" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: unknown target '${nm}'" >&2; return 1
  fi
  local ds="${tgt_deps[${nm}]:-}"
  if [ -n "${ds}" ]; then
    IFS=' ' read -ra dl <<< "${ds}"
    for d in "${dl[@]}"; do
      if ! build "${d}"; then
        echo "ERROR: dep '${d}' failed for '${nm}'" >&2; return 1
      fi
    done
  fi
  echo "==> build: ${nm}"
  local cm="${tgt_cmd[${nm}]}"
  if [ -n "${cm}" ]; then
    if ! eval "${cm}"; then
      echo "ERROR: '${nm}' failed" >&2; return 1
    fi
  fi
  tgt_built["${nm}"]=1
  echo "==> done: ${nm}"
}

mkdir -p "${BD}"
define "clean" "" "rm -rf ${BD}/*"
define "compile" "clean" "gcc -c src/*.c -o ${BD}/main.o"
define "link" "compile" "gcc ${BD}/main.o -o ${BD}/app"
define "test" "link" "${BD}/app --self-test"
define "package" "test" "tar -czf ${BD}/release.tar.gz -C ${BD} app"

goal="${1:-package}"
echo "goal: ${goal}"
if build "${goal}"; then
  echo "BUILD OK"
else
  echo "BUILD FAILED" >&2; exit 1
fi
notes: Implements a build system that resolves target dependencies and runs build commands in order.

title: http router with middleware chain

set -euo pipefail
declare -A routes
declare -a mw_chain
PORT="${1:-8080}"
LOG="/var/log/httpd_${PORT}.log"

mw_log() {
  local m="${1}" p="${2}"
  printf '[%s] %s %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "${m}" "${p}" >>"${LOG}"
}

mw_auth() {
  local m="${1}" p="${2}" h="${3}"
  if [[ "${p}" == /api/* ]]; then
    if [[ "${h}" != *"Authorization:"* ]]; then
      printf 'HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\r\n\r\n{"error":"no token"}\n'
      return 1
    fi
  fi
}

reg() { routes["${1}:${2}"]="${3}"; }

h_index() { echo '{"status":"ok"}'; }
h_health() { echo '{"up":true}'; }
h_users() { echo '{"users":[]}'; }

reg "GET" "/" "h_index"
reg "GET" "/health" "h_health"
reg "GET" "/api/users" "h_users"
mw_chain=("mw_log" "mw_auth")

dispatch() {
  local m="${1}" p="${2}" h="${3}"
  for fn in "${mw_chain[@]}"; do
    "${fn}" "${m}" "${p}" "${h}" || return 1
  done
  local key="${m}:${p}"
  if [ -n "${routes[${key}]+x}" ]; then
    printf 'HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n'
    "${routes[${key}]}"
  else
    printf 'HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found\r\n\r\n{"error":"not found"}\n'
  fi
}

echo "listening :${PORT}"
while true; do
  read -r req
  m="${req%% /*}"; p="${req#* }"; p="${p%% *}"
  hdrs=""
  while IFS= read -r hdr; do
    [ -z "${hdr%%$'\r'}" ] && break
    hdrs="${hdrs} ${hdr}"
  done
  dispatch "${m}" "${p}" "${hdrs}"
done
notes: Implements a basic HTTP router with a pluggable middleware chain for logging and auth.

title: test runner with tap output
code:
set -euo pipefail
declare -a t_names
declare -A t_funcs
declare -A t_results
pass=0; fail=0; skip=0

reg_test() { t_names+=("${1}"); t_funcs["${1}"]="${2}"; }

assert_eq() {
  local exp="${1}" act="${2}" msg="${3:-}"
  if [ "${exp}" != "${act}" ]; then
    echo "#   expected: '${exp}'" >&2
    echo "#   actual:   '${act}'" >&2
    [ -n "${msg}" ] && echo "#   ${msg}" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

assert_ok() {
  local c="${1}" msg="${2:-}"
  if [ "${c}" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "#   want exit 0, got ${c}" >&2
    [ -n "${msg}" ] && echo "#   ${msg}" >&2
    return 1
  fi
}

run_all() {
  local total="${#t_names[@]}"
  echo "TAP version 14"
  echo "1..${total}"
  local idx=0
  for nm in "${t_names[@]}"; do
    idx=$((idx + 1))
    local fn="${t_funcs[${nm}]}"
    if [ -z "${fn}" ]; then
      echo "ok ${idx} - ${nm} # SKIP"
      skip=$((skip + 1)); t_results["${nm}"]="skip"
      continue
    fi
    local out
    if out=$("${fn}" 2>&1); then
      echo "ok ${idx} - ${nm}"
      pass=$((pass + 1)); t_results["${nm}"]="pass"
    else
      echo "not ok ${idx} - ${nm}"
      fail=$((fail + 1)); t_results["${nm}"]="fail"
      while IFS= read -r ln; do
        echo "# ${ln}"
      done <<< "${out}"
    fi
  done
  echo ""
  printf '# pass=%d fail=%d skip=%d\n' "${pass}" "${fail}" "${skip}"
  [ "${fail}" -eq 0 ]
}

t_add() { assert_eq "4" "$(( 2 + 2 ))" "math"; }
t_str() { assert_eq "hello" "hello" "str"; }
t_exit() { true; assert_ok $? "true"; }
t_fail() { assert_eq "1" "2" "deliberate"; }

reg_test "addition" "t_add"
reg_test "string" "t_str"
reg_test "exit code" "t_exit"
reg_test "expect fail" "t_fail"
reg_test "placeholder" ""

run_all
notes: Implements a TAP test runner with assertion helpers, skip support, and formatted output.

title: process supervisor with auto-restart
code:
set -euo pipefail
declare -A pids
declare -A status
declare -A restarts
MAX_R=3; ALIVE=1

log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date +%T)" "$*"; }

shutdown() {
  ALIVE=0; log "shutting down"
  for nm in "${!pids[@]}"; do
    local p="${pids[${nm}]}"
    kill -0 "${p}" 2>/dev/null && { log "stop ${nm} (${p})"; kill -TERM "${p}" 2>/dev/null; }
  done
  wait 2>/dev/null; log "all stopped"; exit 0
}
trap shutdown SIGTERM SIGINT

start() {
  local nm="${1}" cmd="${2}"
  eval "${cmd}" &
  pids["${nm}"]=$!
  status["${nm}"]="up"
  restarts["${nm}"]="${restarts[${nm}]:-0}"
  log "start ${nm} (pid $!)"
}

check() {
  for nm in "${!pids[@]}"; do
    local p="${pids[${nm}]}"
    if ! kill -0 "${p}" 2>/dev/null; then
      wait "${p}" 2>/dev/null || true
      local r="${restarts[${nm}]}"
      if [ "${r}" -ge "${MAX_R}" ]; then
        log "FAIL: ${nm} max restarts (${MAX_R})"
        status["${nm}"]="dead"
      else
        restarts["${nm}"]=$((r + 1))
        log "WARN: ${nm} died, restart #$((r + 1))"
        local c="${svcs[${nm}]}"
        [ -n "${c}" ] && start "${nm}" "${c}"
      fi
    fi
  done
}

declare -A svcs=(
  [web]="python3 -m http.server 8080"
  [worker]="bash -c 'while true; do sleep 10; done'"
  [cron]="bash -c 'while true; do echo tick; sleep 60; done'"
)

log "supervisor (max_restarts=${MAX_R})"
for nm in "${!svcs[@]}"; do
  start "${nm}" "${svcs[${nm}]}"
done

while [ "${ALIVE}" -eq 1 ]; do
  sleep 2; check
  up=0
  for nm in "${!status[@]}"; do
    [ "${status[${nm}]}" = "up" ] && up=$((up + 1))
  done
  [ "${up}" -eq 0 ] && { log "no children alive"; exit 1; }
done
notes: Supervises child processes with automatic restart and graceful signal-driven shutdown.
